services.desc: Original blueprint of the pavilion and arcade of Gray Hall from Sweet Briar’s archives. The discovery of hundreds of blueprints in a back closet in the Physical Plant in 2020 opened the door to a new understanding of the campus as envisioned by Ralph Adams Cram between 1901 and 1936, and of those who would adapt to and live in his buildings afterward. Thanks to these blueprints, we can now track Cram’s works in progress from these initial designs to the impact of others connected to the historic site, from Sweet Briar College presidents Mary K.
